Name: Rare Giant Fishes
Author: vapor64
Description:
Every fish you reel in with a fishing rod now has a small chance to be a rare giant variant: noticeably larger, far more valuable, and displayable in 3 brand new giant fish tanks!


[b][u]How It Works[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Giant Catch Chance:[/b] Any rod-caught fish has a [b]0.1% base chance[/b][configurable] to be giant, plus [b]+0.05% per fishing level[/b] [configurable].[/*]
[*][b]Hook Feedback:[/b] Screen shake and controller rumble trigger the instant a giant bites, giving you tactile warning before reeling it in. A "Giant [Fish]!" banner announces your prize when landed.[/*]
[*][b]Record-Breaking Size:[/b] Giant catches roll sizes well beyond species maximums and can set new personal size records in your fish collection.[/*]
[*][b]Bonus XP:[/b] Awards bonus fishing XP (+50 XP by default) on top of vanilla catch experience.[/*]
[*][b]Exceptions:[/b] Legendary fish, trash, seaweed, green algae, and crab pot catches are never giant.[/*]
[/list]
[b][u]Giant Fish Items & Value[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b]10× Sell Price:[/b] Sells for 10 times the normal base species value. [/*]
[*][b]5× Sustenance:[/b] Restores 5 times the regular health and energy when eaten.[/*]
[*][b]Fish Smoker Compatible:[/b] Can be placed in the Fish Smoker, producing giant smoked fish that retain the full 10× sell value and 5× food bonuses.[/*]
[/list]
[b][u]3 New Giant Fish Tanks[/u][/b]
Giant fish require spacious housing and can only be placed in giant tanks. Giant tanks accommodate giant fish, regular fish, bottom-dwellers, hats, and decorations:
[list]
[*][b]Giant Fish Tank:[/b] Capacity: 2 swimming, 1 ground, 3 decorations. Sold at Willy's Fish Shop (6,000g) or via the Furniture Catalogue.[/*]
[*][b]Deluxe Giant Fish Tank:[/b] Capacity: 3 swimming, 2 ground, 4 decorations. Unlocked and mailed as a free reward upon completing Willy's [i]Tropical Fish[/i] special order, and purchasable from Willy (15,000g) or the Furniture Catalogue.[/*]
[*][b]Giant Aquatic Sanctuary:[/b] Capacity: 5 swimming, 4 ground, 6 decorations. Available in Qi's Walnut Room for 60 Qi Gems.[/*]
[/list]
[b][u]Configurable Values (GMCM Required)[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b]GiantChance:[/b] Base chance for a rod-caught fish to be giant (Default: 0.001 / 0.1%). [/*]
[*][b]GiantChancePerFishingLevel:[/b] Extra chance added per fishing skill level (Default: 0.0005 / +0.05% per level). [/*]
[*][b]GiantXpMultiplier:[/b] Bonus fishing XP awarded for landing a giant catch (Default: 5, internally scaled ×10 = +50 XP).[/*]
[/list]
[b][u]Save Safety & Clean Removal[/u][/b]
This mod is safe to add or remove mid-playthrough. If uninstalled, tanks remain intact as vanilla tanks with their fish and decorations preserved, and giant fish safely revert to normal fish.


Check the in-game Generic Mod Documentation Framework (GMDF) viewer for detailed guides, formulas, and FAQs.

Please consider endorsing this mod if you find it helpful.


[b][u]Installation :[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Download latest mod file
e.g. "[i]RareGiantFishes1.0.0.zip[/i]"[/*]
[*]Extract the contents of the mod file to your Stardew Valley mods folder
e.g. "[i]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\[/i]"[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley using SMAPI[/*]
[/list]
[b][u]Compatibility :[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Tested on Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.1[/*]
[*]Not tested on Android yet[/*]
[*]Multiplayer supported (requires installation by all players; host manages saves)[/*]
[*]Works with Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/*]
[*]Works with Generic Mod Documentation Framework (GMDF)[/*]
[/list]
